Universities Announce Admission and Counselling Schedules for Various Courses

Delhi University has announced the schedule for its Spot Round 1 and BTech Mid-Entry admissions for 2026, including seat acceptance rules. The results for DU's Spot Round 1 are expected on August 25, 2026. Separately, medical counselling has commenced, with NEET repeaters reportedly dominating the participant numbers. The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has also revised dates for NEET UG Counselling 2026's first round of registration and choice filling, with registration open until August 15. Karnataka has announced dates for its DCET 2026 Round 1 counselling.
